Abhinav Tripathi, Founder of JR Airlines, built a private aviation business from a flight he couldn't book an air ambulance he could trust for his father
He explains:
• Why India has only 215 private jets despite being one of the world's fastest-growing economies
• How charter pricing works: why you pay for the aircraft's full journey, not just your seat
• What it actually costs to run one private jet every year: the real Rs 25 crore number broken down
• How private jet brokers in India make money without owning a single aircraft
